definitions: To hold a grudge or grievance that makes one quick to take offence.
To be resentful because of a past injustice or perceived disadvantage.
examples: He's always had a chip on his shoulder about not getting promoted.
She seems to have a chip on her shoulder regarding her upbringing.
Don't mention his exam results; he has a real chip on his shoulder about them.
lemma: to have a chip on one's shoulder
source: to have a chip on one's shoulder
